test_nanops_functions: test nanops functions like nanany, nanall, nansum, nanmean, nanmedian, nanvar, nanstd, nansem, nanargmax, nanargmin, nanmax, nanmin, nanskew, nankurt, nanprod against numpy equivalents with skipna support
test_nanvar_variance: test nanvar computes variance correctly with skipna, ddof, axis parameters and handles all finite, nan, and mixed data
test_nanskew_skewness: test nanskew computes skewness correctly with skipna, axis parameters and handles constant series and low variance data
test_nankurt_kurtosis: test nankurt computes kurtosis correctly with skipna, axis parameters and handles constant series and low variance data
test_nancorr_nancov: test nancorr and nancov compute correlation and covariance with pearson, kendall, spearman methods on 1d and 2d arrays
